Name: Vanilla Tweaks EBAGI Patches hub SVE RSV CMC
Author: melonuwu
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#b6d7a8]What is this?[/color][/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#cccccc]
This is a hub for [/color][color=#fff2cc]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/color][color=#cccccc] content packs, providing icons in the style of the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks - Producer Edition[/url] for each unique artisan good item added by various mods.

Currently includes packs for: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29217]
EBAGI - Vanilla Tweaks Icons[/url]﻿[/color][color=#cccccc] - Provides a content pack for vanilla items and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]﻿, so those are not included here.[/color][/b][b][color=#d8d8d8]
[b]

[/b][/color][/b][/size][size=6][b][color=#b6d7a8]Requirements
[/color][/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8][b][color=#cccccc]Requires[/color][/b][/color][/b][/size][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8][b][color=#cccccc] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8][b][color=#cccccc][b][color=#cccccc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/color][/b][/color][/b][/color][/b][/size],[b][color=#cccccc] and[size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8][b][color=#cccccc] [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods Icons[/url], as well as the requisite mod for the pack you are downloading.[/color][/b][/color][/b][/size] 

[/color][/b][/color][/b][/color][/b][/size][size=6][b][color=#b6d7a8]Install[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][b][color=#cccccc]1. Install Requirements
2. If using Vortex/MO2 navigate to the files tab and select "Download with Manager" and skip step 3.
3. If downloading Manually, simply place "EBAGI VT Style Icons for CMC.zip" in your mods folder located in the same directory as StardewValley.exe
4. Thats it, the mod should load the next time you launch SMAPI.

Its also highly recommended to use alongside the actual Vanilla Tweaks suite:[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21433]Vanilla Tweaks | Aquarium Edition[/url] - new looks for your Aquarium Fish, caught Fishes, Tackles and Baits, Treasure finds and Trash![/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21351]Vanilla Tweaks | Caves Edition[/url] - new looks for your Minerals, Gems, Geodes, Mining Nodes, Rocks and Resources!﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21436]﻿﻿Vanilla Tweaks | Interface Edition[/url]﻿ - provide you a few GUI Changes and new visual for your Skill Icons!﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks | Producer Edition[/url]﻿ - new looks for your Food, Artisan Goods and Pierre's Store Ingredients![/size]
[*][size=2]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21435]Vanilla Tweaks | Warrior Edition[/url]﻿ - new looks for Elixirs and Medicine, Monster Loot, Rings, Shoes, Tools and Weapons!﻿﻿﻿[/size]
[/list][/color][/b][/size]
